apiJson.prose: SkyHarbor Air's loaded context supports a portfolio-led view of IT and business organization. Technology accountability is visible across business functions, IT domains, application ownership, and executive/role-level leadership, which supports an operating-model synthesis before any caveats. Named technology and executive leaders are loaded where the evidence provides them, including Evan Kline (CTO), Amala Rao (CIO), Owen Mercer (CISO), Samir Nadeem (CDO), Priya Sethi (General Counsel). The operating model coverage includes 20 business-function areas, 18 IT/technology domains, and 900 application-to-team ownership links. That lets aVa explain who is accountable by domain, which portfolios the teams support, and where applications connect back to technology ownership. The main caveat is precision: Some role-level accountabilities are not tied to named people.
